rationale: Both catch the orphaned <sup>H3</sup>/missing AMD checkmark in supported_models.md, the strongest diff-grounded finding shared with GT (Xunzhuo's ask to update that table). X additionally nails the single most emphasized GT concern — the mkdocs --strict docs-build failure caused by the recipes.vllm.ai link at supported_models.md:105 — with the exact same root cause and fix as hsliuustc0106's inline comment (mis-filed as a 'nit' rather than blocking, but substantively correct); Y never mentions the docs build failure at all despite it being CHANGES_REQUESTED and raised three separate times. X also brushes against the 'separate minimax-h3-rocm.md' preference via its MiniMax-H3-MUSA.md file-convention nit, which Y lacks entirely. Both are actionable with file/line anchors and concrete fixes, X marginally more so via drafted replacement text.
